question: Should OpenClaw support session completion automation through a new internal `session:end` hook, through the existing typed plugin `session_end` hook, or through a narrower reset-specific hook surface?
rationale: The code already has a plugin lifecycle hook for session end, while this issue asks for the separate internal hook system; choosing between those surfaces is an API/product boundary decision, not a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Define the lifecycle surface first
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide which hook surface is canonical before landing or closing the linked implementation candidates.

options.title: Adopt plugin session_end
options.body: Document the typed plugin `session_end` hook as the supported workflow-integration path and close the internal-hook request once docs make that clear.

options.title: Add internal session:end
options.body: Sponsor a focused implementation that adds a typed internal event, wires the approved completion paths, and updates tests and public hook docs.

recommendation.title: Define the lifecycle surface first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide which hook surface is canonical before landing or closing the linked implementation candidates.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has recent plugin hook contract history and is already involved in the active linked hook PR discussion.
